pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Express Uncertainty Without System Status Claims
lesson.when: A customer asks for specific detail or past context that is missing from provided sources or tool results
lesson.do: State clearly that the information is unavailable in the provided data and express uncertainty without inventing specific system limitation details
lesson.otherwise: Do not claim that the system lacks specific confirmation records or functionality unless explicitly supported by sources
triggers: hỏi thông tin không có trong dữ liệu
